description: Asset import: every file an asset library reads goes through one file-I/O interface, and an import's output depends only on its input, the library's version and its settings.

usage.description: When the library runs: in the game, in build tools that cook assets, or both.

file_io_hook.description: How the library's file reads are injected, such as a read callback or an API that takes bytes instead of a path, or null when it reads files itself.

reload_hook.description: How loaded data is reloaded when its source file changes, or null.

output_settings.description: The settings that change an import's output, beyond its input and the library's version.

rules.text: Every file the library reads goes through the file-I/O interface: a probe that has the glue load a sample asset, with the files it refers to, sees the interface serve each one.
Importing the same input twice, with the same library version and settings, gives identical output.
A library whose loaded data the game keeps is reloaded through its reload hook when a source file changes, and the reload reads through the file-I/O interface too.
